phase_1.reason: Phase 4 directly tests held-out description-length savings and Phase 5 tests temporal growth; the weaker within-snapshot vocabulary curve is omitted

definition.component_count: distinct referenced callee methods outside the selected boundary
definition.conditioning: 20 classfile-size quantile bins; z-score within bins having >=100 programs

definition.population: concrete methods targeted by EXACT STATIC or SPECIAL bytecode calls
definition.identifier_boundary: ceil(log2(rank)) is a global theoretical minimum; JVM call sites use a 16-bit class-local constant-pool index plus shared metadata

phase_4_mdl_incompleteness.status: exploratory MDL proxy; opcode macros are not verified Java APIs

definition.eligible_methods: non-synthetic, straight-line, exception-free methods with 4..512 instructions
definition.candidate: normalized opcode n-gram of length 4..8 seen in >=3 training packages; occurrences of the same candidate cannot overlap within a method
definition.heldout_savings: fragment bytes - 3 bytes per macro reference - definition bytes - 8 bytes per referencing class
definition.limitation: stack contracts, operands, semantic naming, access rules, and verifier-safe rewriting are not yet modeled

definition.growth_test: declarations added and removed between official binary snapshots
definition.adoption_test: JDK 28 resolved calls from retained method identities to added callees
definition.limitation: two snapshots cannot establish unbounded growth; retained method identity does not prove an unchanged implementation, and gross bytecode savings is not causal

interpretation.finite_snapshot_incomplete: supported as a finite longitudinal observation: the newer snapshot adds methods and retained method identities call some of them
